evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “August Underway with 271 New Federal Immigration Cases in Western District of Texas,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: Federal prosecutors in the Western District of Texas filed 271 new immigration and immigration-related criminal cases from July 31 through August 6 This current source item can be tested against the underlying record and connected to the relevant evidence lane.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
